eyebrow: K.A.P.I.T Global · Onboarding & Integration · Mentoring and business growth
hook: Have a business idea you keep putting off? Start here.
intro: K.A.P.I.T Global is a mentoring platform for people with a business idea, new entrepreneurs, emerging leaders and anyone working on their own growth. Onboarding & Integration is how you get started: a short screening to check it's a good fit, then your paperwork and setup, then orientation and training. An internship is part of it too.

bullets.text: so you and K.A.P.I.T Global both know it's a good fit before anything else.
sorted at the start, so they don't hold you up later.
plus two weekly intro sessions: one on onboarding, one on the internship.

hostNote: brings K.A.P.I.T Global's Onboarding & Integration to NowTRANSFORMED

heroImage.alt: A woman stands to shake hands with a man across a table while four colleagues smile, in a bright office meeting

why.title: Most ideas stall at the first step.
paragraphs: You know what you want to build, or who you want to become. What's usually missing is the next concrete step, and someone to check your thinking with.

K.A.P.I.T Global helps people turn what they know, their ideas and their potential into action and results, through mentorship, personal development and business growth opportunities. In its own words, the mission is to transform potential into progress. Onboarding & Integration is where that starts.

story.title: Who you'll be working with
paragraphs: K.A.P.I.T Global (also written KAPIT Global) is a transformation and mentoring platform. It works with aspiring entrepreneurs, people with business ideas, emerging leaders, and anyone who wants to grow personally and professionally.
Your free call is with the NowTRANSFORMED team. Criztal, a NowTRANSFORMED Coach, brings this offer to NowTRANSFORMED.

image.alt: A smiling woman in glasses stands with her arms folded in front of a team working at a long table

faqs.a: Aspiring entrepreneurs, people with a business idea, emerging leaders, and anyone working on their personal and professional growth.
The team asks what you're hoping to do, explains how Onboarding & Integration works and answers your questions. There's no obligation to sign up.
You'll get the exact price on your free call. If you're a good fit, you may qualify for a NowTRANSFORMED sponsorship toward this offer, and we'll explain that on the call too.
The weekly Intro to Internship session covers it, and you can ask on your free call too.
Intro to Onboarding and Intro to Internship each run once a week. Ask on your free call for the day, time and how to join.

closing.title: Ready to act on your idea?
closing.text: A free 15-minute call. Pick a time that works for you.
